findings.text: follow-on: _text_search_wiki_chunks still binds its query text to a Cypher parameter named `query` (the Cypher at :904 binds $query and the call at :911 passes query=query), the same collision repaired in the signal (:514) and code-chunk (:1654/:1663) searches. GraphClient.query forwards **params to sess.run(cypher, **params), and Session.run's first argument is itself named query, so the call raises TypeError('got multiple values for argument query'); the function swallows it with a bare `except Exception:` at :914, so the wiki-chunk fulltext branch never runs and every documentation prose search falls back to the CONTAINS scan at fixed score 0.5. I confirmed the collision shape directly (Session.run signature plus the query= kwargs reaching it) and the head source still carries query=query at :911. The run records this deliberately as a follow-on because repairing it perturbs which documentation chunks rank (BM25 hits displaced the vector-matched EDDB manual chunks, per commit 711cfe87a), so the docs side of the flux-loop proof runs through the fallback rather than BM25.

justifications.durability: The change is durably protected. The per-chunk cap has a real, non-tautological guard (test_stub_chunk_enrichment_query_is_capped), which I falsified independently by removing the slice. Both repaired fulltext branches now carry regression tests that drive them through a GraphClient stub whose query(self, query, **params) signature mirrors Session.run, so binding the text to query again raises rather than passing unnoticed: I verified all three mutations redden the matching test and the unmutated head passes all twelve. The narrowed except is pinned in both directions (a TypeError propagates, a ClientError still falls back). Residual: the wiki-chunk text search keeps the same collision and a bare except, untested and still on the CONTAINS fallback (see the finding).
justifications.evidence: Strong and independently reproduced. Both gate arms run to their summary line (baseline 618 passed at c323401f9 in a scratch extraction, head 630 passed at 990339648 in the reviewed worktree, both EXIT=0). The declared negative control reproduces exactly (dropping the per-chunk cap slice makes test_stub_chunk_enrichment_query_is_capped the sole failure, EXIT=1). I falsified each repaired behaviour: reverting the signal rename (search_query -> query) reddens test_signal_fulltext_branch_binds_search_query; broadening the signal except back to 'except Exception' reddens test_signal_fulltext_programming_error_propagates; and I showed the defect itself - at baseline _text_search_signals returns the CONTAINS fallback with a query= kwarg while at head it returns the fulltext hit and a genuine KeyError propagates. One qualification: the reviewed manifest carries baseline_suite=null, so the baseline arm is mine, not the run's.
justifications.fit: The node extends the owners the plan names and the brief's reuse map: _fetch_wiki_page, _enrich_signals and the _search_docs/formatter path in imas_codex/llm/, reusing the existing WikiChunk DOCUMENTS edge with no new edge, no new MCP tool and no new parameter. It adds only small module-private helpers and three named caps. The one new enrichment key (documented_pages) and the signals section are the smallest surface that makes the plan's proof true. No abstraction, no sibling module, no interface widening.
justifications.goal_fidelity: section 3's MCP done-when is met and independently reproduced live at head 990339648 against the jt-60sa graph: fetch of a fronts_database page returns the catalogue it fronts grouped by data class with counts and a bounded sample instead of the empty form, search_signals prints the page citation for a DOCUMENTS-linked signal, and search_docs returns the flux-loop signals beside the documentation. A point off because the documentation prose ranking is carried by the CONTAINS fallback rather than the BM25 branch (see the wiki-chunk follow-on), so the docs side is not on its intended path.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status c323401f9..990339648 lists exactly the four declared paths and nothing outside the grant. No plan HTML, facility YAML, schema, sibling scanner or wiki-pipeline file was touched. Commit subjects are conventional with bodies and carry no plan/sprint/ticket labels and (checked) no AI trailer; symbol and file names describe mechanism, not plan items. The reviewer's own scope is the two review JSON paths.
